name: Flensing Trap (5-6)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future

disable: DC 23 Thievery check (expert) to disable the pressure plate

items.name: Eviscerate
items.text:
Trigger Weight is removed from the trapped floor tile

---

Effect Blades extend from the floor, ceiling, and walls of the surrounding hallways to eviscerate all creatures in the area, dealing 2d10+7 slashing damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save save). Creatures that critically fail also take 1d4 bleed damage.

text: Rotating blades extend from the walls, floors, and ceiling of the surrounding halls when weight is removed from the trapped floor tile.
